title: Risk score
short_explanation: A deterministic number summarizing weighted factors detected in the workflow.
why_it_matters: It helps compare raw and residual risk without relying on a model.

title: Evidence
short_explanation: The exact text fragment or pattern that triggered a finding.
why_it_matters: Evidence makes the audit explainable and reviewable.

title: Control
short_explanation: A defensive safeguard that can reduce or govern a risk factor.
why_it_matters: Controls turn findings into practical implementation boundaries.

title: Residual risk
short_explanation: The estimated risk after selected controls are applied in a local simulation.
why_it_matters: It shows what may remain even after safeguards.

title: Human-in-the-loop
short_explanation: A named human role validates high-impact recommendations before action.
why_it_matters: Human validation prevents unsafe autonomous decisions.

title: Local-first privacy
short_explanation: Analysis, storage, and reports stay on the local machine.
why_it_matters: Local operation reduces exposure and avoids cloud dependencies.

title: Deterministic scoring
short_explanation: The same workflow text produces the same findings and scores.
why_it_matters: Repeatability is essential for tests and audit explanations.

title: Optional local LLM enrichment
short_explanation: A local model may rephrase narrative text only.
why_it_matters: It must never decide findings, controls, scores, or residual risk.

title: Raw risk vs residual risk
short_explanation: Raw risk is before controls; residual risk is after simulated controls.
why_it_matters: This separation keeps planning clear.

title: Recommendations are simulated only
short_explanation: The tool does not execute email, HR, SOC, finance, CRM, or production actions.
why_it_matters: A portfolio-safe boundary avoids real-world side effects.
